newsitem.title: CHINA: China unfolds mystery of disappearing city.
newsitem.headline: China unfolds mystery of disappearing city.

text.p: China's military revealed on Friday that "secrets" had been sold for 0.80 yuan ($0.10) to an unidentified large Western state, solving the mystery of a large industrial city that disappeared from satellite photographs.

Western intelligence assumed China was carrying out experiments in the northwestern city of Lanzhou after the city failed to show up on satellite photographs taken in the winter of 1990, the China Defence News said.

However, Western "specialists" sent to the area posing as tourists concluded from extensive tests that heavy air pollution had caused a thick cloud of smog to form over the city making it invisible to satellites, it said.

Unconvinced Western intelligence ordered another investigation, but the "specialists" proved their case with a Chinese environmental report, bought for 0.8 yuan ($0.1), that cited air pollution as the cause for the city's disappearance, it said.
